proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3103 kāleyaka expressly discusses the heart/liver semantic overlap and gives Hindi karejā heart/liver, Assamese kɔlizā heart and Gujarati kāḷjũ heart/liver. The survey kalja/kaleja/kareja heart words fit this explicitly documented sense family. Exact survey form kaleja is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12487 śītala explicitly lists Gawri šalá cold, Hindi sīlā cool and Torwali/Palula šidul/šidālo with unexplained d. Its addendum qualifies l/lh forms as *śītalla or crossed with *śaitalya. The containing article is used with those phonological qualifications retained, not as a claim of regular unmodified inheritance. Exact survey form śila is preserved.
